detail.longDescription: Hi HN, I’ve been building Kival, an open-source, self-hosted knowledge system for organizations. The idea is a collaborative knowledge space for teams and agents, where each contribution to the shared knowledge can meaningfully improve the output of their next tasks. It’s written in Rust, backed by PostgreSQL, and ships with a web app, CLI, and SDKs. Still early, so I’d really appreciate any feedback :)
